items: Roomy enough with 3 compartments for all your daily stuff. The computer compartment in the middle provides a thick padded foam section with a hook & loop strap closure for your laptop or tablet. Professional design to protect your laptop against accidental impacts and scratches. The other two side compartments & matching color small pouch case can store your jewelry, mobile phone, keys, mouse, passports, credit cards, cash, makeups and so on

Made of waterproof PU leather material, durable and fashion. Removable and adjustable padding shoulder strap varied from 31.89-maximum 53.93 inch. Removable shoulder strap allows you to carry it as a cross body bag, shoulder bag or tote bag. The detachable silk scarf makes your bag stylish and elegant. Reinforced bottom with 4 rivets protects your bag from damage

This attractive fashionable front embossed retro hibiscus waterproof PU leather laptop tote bag is ideal for daily use at shopping, office, business trip, work, weekend, outdoor activities, outdoor holiday, travel, gyms, camp, etc. Nice size admirably suits women and adults
